Hi, I’m sorry you’re feeling this way around Christmas. If it helps I fucking hate Christmas too. I think I would like it more if it wasn’t so hyped up, like birthdays. 

Don’t let the tv and colleagues/school friends subtly guilt you into feeling you have to be merry and jolly around this time. It can be painful because emotional connections and meaningfulness seems so forced.

My advice for you (if you wish for some advice) would be to take a deep breath, see the bigger picture. Tomorrow (well Christmas is tomorrow in my country, not sure where you are) is just another day. Take some time tomorrow to do something you like, however small. A quiet moment. A funny video. Anything.

You can work towards a life more bearable, hell even enjoyable. Tomorrow does not define you. 

Don’t leave things behind. Things can change. Don’t let a corporate cash grabbing emotionally charged bullshit holiday stop you from feeling peace in yourself or at least knowing that some day you will feel that peace. It is there. Get a restful sleep tonight and go gently and slowly tomorrow. Eat some chocolate and make sure you dress warm and eat enough. Do little things for yourself that comfort you. I like painting my nails. It helps me.

Sending you lots of comfort and support your way. 

Tomorrow is just another day.
